theme_ko: 시즌 1 · 시즌 피날레, 엇갈리는 로스와 레이첼

words.def_en: pleasant but also sad at the same time
words.ex_en: Rachel's goodbye to the old gang felt bittersweet.
words.ex_ko: 레이첼에게 옛 친구들과의 작별은 씁쓸하면서도 달콤했다.
words.scene_ko: 한 시즌이 마무리되며 여러 감정이 교차하는 상황

words.def_en: feeling happy and a little sad about the past
words.ex_en: Monica gets nostalgic whenever she sees old photos.
words.ex_ko: 모니카는 옛 사진을 볼 때마다 향수에 젖는다.

words.ex_en: Ross felt vulnerable after telling Rachel the truth.
words.ex_ko: 로스는 레이첼에게 진실을 말한 뒤 마음이 약해졌다.

words.def_en: slow to act because you are unsure
words.ex_en: Joey was hesitant to say anything about it.
words.scene_ko: 중요한 말을 할까 말까 고민하는 상황

words.def_en: pleased because someone praised or liked you
words.ex_en: Phoebe was flattered that he remembered her song.
words.ex_ko: 피비는 그가 자기 노래를 기억해서 기분이 좋았다.
words.scene_ko: 누군가의 호감 표현에 기분이 좋아지는 상황

words.def_en: so shocked that you cannot react
words.ex_en: Everyone was stunned when Ross walked in.
words.scene_ko: 예상 밖의 소식에 말문이 막히는 상황

words.def_en: happy because a worry has gone away
words.ex_en: Chandler was relieved that the meeting was over.
Ross was heartbroken when he heard the news.
words.ex_ko: 로스는 그 소식을 듣고 가슴이 무너졌다.

words.def_en: a feeling that a difficult matter has ended
words.ex_en: Monica needed some closure after the breakup.
words.ex_ko: 모니카는 이별 후 마음의 정리가 필요했다.
words.scene_ko: 지난 관계에 마침표를 찍고 싶은 상황

words.def_en: always together and impossible to separate
words.ex_en: Joey and Chandler are practically inseparable.
words.ex_ko: 조이와 챈들러는 거의 떨어질 수 없는 사이다.
words.scene_ko: 늘 붙어 다니는 친구들을 묘사하는 상황

idioms.en: wear your heart on your sleeve
idioms.ex_en: Ross wears his heart on his sleeve around Rachel.
idioms.ex_ko: 로스는 레이첼 앞에서 감정을 숨기지 못한다.
idioms.scene_ko: 속마음이 얼굴에 다 드러나는 로스 같은 상황

idioms.def_en: doing something late is better than not doing it
idioms.ex_en: You finally called her? Better late than never.
idioms.ex_ko: 드디어 그녀에게 전화했어? 늦어도 안 하는 것보단 낫지.

idioms.def_en: to forget past arguments and move on
idioms.ex_en: Let's let bygones be bygones and stay friends.
idioms.ex_ko: 지난 일은 잊고 계속 친구로 지내자.

idioms.en: cross that bridge when we come to it
idioms.def_en: to deal with a problem only when it happens
idioms.ex_en: What if she says no? We'll cross that bridge later.
idioms.ex_ko: 그녀가 싫다고 하면? 그건 그때 가서 생각하자.
idioms.scene_ko: 고백 결과를 걱정하는 친구를 달래는 상황

idioms.ex_en: Carol and Susan finally decided to tie the knot.

idioms.def_en: to say something that has been bothering you
idioms.ex_en: I just need to get this off my chest, Rachel.

idioms.en: the writing is on the wall
idioms.def_en: signs show something bad will happen
idioms.ex_en: The writing was on the wall for their relationship.
idioms.ex_ko: 그들의 관계가 어떻게 될지는 불 보듯 뻔했다.

idioms.ex_en: Her call was a bolt from the blue for Ross.

idioms.def_en: to finish something in a very positive way
idioms.ex_en: Let's end the night on a high note, guys.
idioms.scene_ko: 시즌 마지막 날 모두 모인 자리

idioms.def_en: to finally do something risky or important
idioms.ex_en: Monica decided to take the plunge and change jobs.

phrasal.def_en: to start talking about your feelings
phrasal.ex_en: Rachel finally opened up to Monica about her fears.
Let me wrap up this shift and I'll join you.

phrasal.def_en: to go with someone to say goodbye
phrasal.ex_en: We all went to the airport to see Ross off.
phrasal.ex_ko: 우리 모두 로스를 배웅하러 공항에 갔다.

phrasal.ex_en: Don't worry, Phoebe will pull through this.
phrasal.ex_ko: 걱정 마, 피비는 이걸 이겨낼 거야.
phrasal.scene_ko: 힘든 일을 겪는 친구를 응원하는 상황

phrasal.ex_en: Let's talk it over before you decide anything.
phrasal.ex_ko: 뭘 결정하기 전에 충분히 얘기해 보자.
phrasal.scene_ko: 중요한 결정 앞에서 친구와 상의하는 상황

phrasal.def_en: to fix a relationship after a fight
phrasal.ex_en: Joey wants to patch things up with his sister.

phrasal.def_en: to accept something less than you wanted
phrasal.ex_en: Rachel refuses to settle for a boring life.
phrasal.scene_ko: 더 나은 삶을 원하는 레이첼의 상황

phrasal.ex_en: Ross worried they would drift apart over time.
phrasal.ex_ko: 로스는 시간이 지나면 서로 멀어질까 걱정했다.

phrasal.def_en: to stop yourself from doing or saying something
phrasal.ex_en: He couldn't hold back his tears at the party.
phrasal.ex_ko: 그는 파티에서 눈물을 참을 수 없었다.

phrasal.def_en: to stand in a row or arrange in advance
phrasal.ex_en: Monica has everything lined up for the party.
phrasal.ex_ko: 모니카는 파티 준비를 다 해 두었다.
